words.gloss: he who lives in domestic life
and to the three classes of people

literal: He who is called a householder is a support standing in the good path for the three who have natural duties.
translation: He who is said to live the domestic life is a steadfast support in the righteous path for the three classes of people who follow their natural duties.
modern: இல்வாழ்க்கை வாழ்பவன் என்று சொல்லப்படுபவன், தன் இயல்புடைய மூன்று பிரிவினருக்கும் நல்ல வழியில் நிலைத்து நிற்கும் துணையாவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the primary role of a householder (இல்வாழ்வான்) as a pillar of support for three other groups of people (மூவர்) who depend on him. These three groups represent individuals in other stages of life who cannot sustain themselves. The householder must support them not just materially, but by remaining firmly established in the 'good path' (நல்லாறு) of virtue. By staying righteous himself, he becomes a reliable 'support' (துணை) that enables others to fulfill their own natural duties.
